title: Conversion Buffer on Re-Sent Payout Methods Balances
content:
When returned money is re-sent to a Payout Methods method paid in a currency other than USD, the conversion rate may have moved between the return and the settlement of the re-send. The re-send conversion buffer keeps back part of the amount the returned transfer booked back to the method, to cover the movement of the conversion rate between the return and the settlement of the re-send: 1.40 percent of that returned amount when the method is paid in MXN or CAD, 1.00 percent when it is paid in GBP or EUR, and nothing when it is paid in USD. The buffer stays in the balance for the next scheduled run.

## Buffer by payout currency

| The method's payout currency | Conversion buffer |
|---|---|
| MXN | 1.40 percent of the returned amount |
| CAD | 1.40 percent of the returned amount |
| GBP | 1.00 percent of the returned amount |
| EUR | 1.00 percent of the returned amount |
| USD | Nothing |

## Terms

- **Returned amount.** The amount the returned transfer booked back to the method, read from the latest return entry on the method's ledger. It is not the held balance: credits, releases and fees on the method do not change it.
- **Payout currency.** The currency the host receives, as shown on the payout method's record.
- The buffer is carried unrounded.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Imagined method | Returned amount | Conversion buffer |
|---|---|---|
| International Wire Transfer paid in MXN | USD 2150.00 | 1.40 percent: USD 30.10 |
| PayPal paid in GBP | USD 640.00 | 1.00 percent: USD 6.40 |
| Western Union Cash Pickup paid in USD | USD 900.00 | Nothing |
| International Wire Transfer paid in CAD | USD 2345.67 | 1.40 percent: USD 32.83938, carried unrounded |
